c: While Wicked Season (XIII) is active, overall

When each stat is double, the item representing that stat appear below the health bar and a colored half circle background acts as the timer as it shrinks to the middle, with colors reminiscent of seasons (blue, green, yellow, red). Every level up gives +0.5% to all of those stats.
The Arcana only starts giving stat boosts when the player selects it, and does not give extra stats retroactively. If the stats are desirable, select the Arcana early.
As it gives scaling Growth and Curse, it can be extremely powerful at ramping up the power of the character.

The additional 200% HP bonus enemies gain in Inverse Mode makes this a much riskier choice when playing on this mode due to Curse boosts to enemy speed and HP making it easier to get swarmed. As such, the player may want to buy this Arcana from
and pair it with
, or vice versa, if seeking it early in the run, in order to prevent the run being ended early.

The player has 100% base Growth, Luck, Greed and Curse before modifications. These base values will be doubled by the Arcana as well, giving an effective +100% boost on top of doubling increases to those stats.
